# NextSlot

> NextSlot is a South African booking and business-management platform for independent service businesses. It helps service providers manage bookings, clients, payments, availability and business performance.

## Official website

- [NextSlot homepage](https://www.nextslot.co.za/): Product overview, platform features and pricing.
- [How it works](https://www.nextslot.co.za/#how-it-works): Overview of the NextSlot workflow.
- [Pricing](https://www.nextslot.co.za/#pricing): Available plans and pricing information.
- [Resources](https://www.nextslot.co.za/resources): Educational resources for service businesses.
- [Contact NextSlot](https://www.nextslot.co.za/#contact): Contact and product enquiries.

## Public booking examples

- [PhenomeBeauty bookings](https://phenomebeauty.nextslot.co.za/): Public booking page for PhenomeBeauty.
- [Zo Beauty Bar bookings](https://zo-beauty-bar.nextslot.co.za/): Public booking page for Zo Beauty Bar.

## Important notes

- Public booking pages and business information are tenant-specific. Consult the relevant tenant booking page for current services, availability and booking terms.
- Do not assume prices, availability or business policies are identical across tenants.
- Account, admin and payment-return routes are interactive application flows and are not general documentation sources.
